durableFields.notes: Existing discovery results carry weaponAttack route events derived from typed weapon Attack subject shape and TargetChoice initial hole facts.

Existing resolution results carry weaponAttack route events derived from submitted targetChoice, attackRoll, and rolledDice fills plus resolved or needs-holes result shape. Invalid route events are limited to the two established weapon Attack ordering invalid-fill messages.
Existing typed Attack action subject facts feed the reducer; production route behavior does not dispatch on authored weapon or source identity.
Existing targetChoice fills satisfy the first weapon Attack ordering frontier and advance to Attack Roll holes.
Existing Attack Roll fills route through the attack-roll owner and either resolve a miss or expose rolledDice holes on a hit.
Existing rolledDice fills route hit damage through the Hit Point owner after Attack Roll success.
Existing target Hit Points own durable damage results; Task 62 introduced no parallel damage or HP ledger.
Existing Temporary Hit Points remain part of Hit Point damage application and are not copied into route evidence state.
Generic weaponAttack route subject is derived from typed BattleSubject shape, not authored identity or connector filenames.

Weapon Attack ordering route owners are derived from public discovery and fill/result shape: action economy for discovery, target selection for targetChoice, attack-roll owner for Attack Roll, hole frontier only for the two ordering invalid-fill messages, and Hit Point owner for damage. Invalid out-of-order route events preserve the still-open targetChoice or attackRoll frontier rather than storing a separate ordering ledger.

notes: Task 62 introduced no new durable BattleState fields.
Weapon/source identity remains a typed attack fact selected at the boundary; production route behavior uses subject, fill, hole, result shape, and established ordering invalid-fill messages.
Route evidence records executable-boundary projection state only; it does not duplicate target choice, Attack Roll, damage dice, HP, or invalid-fill state.
